name: 12 Hour Clock
description: A running 12-hour clock with AM and PM.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ function pad(s){s=""+s;return s.length<2?"0"+s:s;} var t=env.absTime+p.offset*3600; var h=Math.floor(t/3600)%24,m=Math.floor(t/60)%60,s=Math.floor(t)%60; var ap=h<12?"AM":"PM"; var h12=h%12; if(h12===0)h12=12; el.text=h12+":"+pad(m)+":"+pad(s)+" "+ap; return el; }
